entries.title: Zechariah 9:1
segments: ¶The burden of the word of the LORD in the land of Hadrach, and Damascus [shall be] the rest thereof: when the eyes of man, as of all the tribes of Israel, [shall be] toward the LORD.

entries.title: Zechariah 9:2
segments: And Hamath also shall border thereby; Tyrus, and Zidon, though it be very wise.

entries.title: Zechariah 9:3
segments: And Tyrus did build herself a strong hold, and heaped up silver as the dust, and fine gold as the mire of the streets.

entries.title: Zechariah 9:4
segments: Behold, the Lord will cast her out, and he will smite her power in the sea; and she shall be devoured with fire.

entries.title: Zechariah 9:5
segments: Ashkelon shall see [it], and fear; Gaza also [shall see it], and be very sorrowful, and Ekron; for her expectation shall be ashamed; and the king shall perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.

words.text: also [shall see it], and be very

entries.title: Zechariah 9:6
segments: And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.

entries.title: Zechariah 9:7
segments: And I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth: but he that remaineth, even he, [shall be] for our God, and he shall be as a governor in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite. {blood: Heb. bloods}

words.text: , even he, [shall be] for our God
, and he shall be as a governor

entries.title: Zechariah 9:8
segments: And I will encamp about mine house because of the army, because of him that passeth by, and because of him that returneth: and no oppressor shall pass through them any more: for now have I seen with mine eyes.

words.text: , because of him that passeth by
, and because of him that returneth
them any more: for now have I seen

entries.title: Zechariah 9:9
segments: ¶Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee: he [is] just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass. {having...: or, saving himself}

entries.title: Zechariah 9:10
segments: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem, and the battle bow shall be cut off: and he shall speak peace unto the heathen: and his dominion [shall be] from sea [even] to sea, and from the river [even] to the ends of the earth.

entries.title: Zechariah 9:11
segments: As for thee also, by the blood of thy covenant I have sent forth thy prisoners out of the pit wherein [is] no water. {by...: or, whose covenant is by blood}

words.text: As for thee also, by the blood
. {by...: or, whose covenant is by blood}

entries.title: Zechariah 9:12
segments: ¶Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope: even to day do I declare [that] I will render double unto thee;

entries.title: Zechariah 9:13
segments: When I have bent Judah for me, filled the bow with Ephraim, and raised up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece, and made thee as the sword of a mighty man.

entries.title: Zechariah 9:14
segments: And the LORD shall be seen over them, and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning: and the Lord GOD shall blow the trumpet, and shall go with whirlwinds of the south.

entries.title: Zechariah 9:15
segments: The LORD of hosts shall defend them; and they shall devour, and subdue with sling stones; and they shall drink, [and] make a noise as through wine; and they shall be filled like bowls, [and] as the corners of the altar. {with...: or, the stones of the sling} {be...: or, fill both the bowls, etc}

words.text: . {with...: or, the stones of the sling} {be...: or, fill both the bowls, etc}

entries.title: Zechariah 9:16
segments: And the LORD their God shall save them in that day as the flock of his people: for they [shall be as] the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon his land.

words.text: : for they [shall be as] the stones

entries.title: Zechariah 9:17
segments: For how great [is] his goodness, and how great [is] his beauty! corn shall make the young men cheerful, and new wine the maids. {cheerful: or, grow, or, speak}
